We employ Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) and Area Under the Precision-Recall curve (PR-AUC) as our primary evaluation metrics. AUROC assesses the ability of a hallucination detection method to correctly rank positive and negative instances (hallucinations vs. non-hallucinations). PR-AUC is particularly valuable when dealing with imbalanced datasets, which is often the case in hallucination detection, where non-hallucinated responses might be more frequent.
